title: Fixed Indexed Annuities — Interest and Index Crediting, Rate Renewals and Reallocations
content:
## Contract provision: crediting (Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities)

**1. Fixed account.** Money in the fixed account earns the current fixed rate, declared each contract year and never below the tier's lowest fixed account rate ever declared.

**2. Indexed strategies.** Money in an indexed strategy is credited once a year, on the contract anniversary. The annual point-to-point cap strategy credits the S&P 500 change over the contract year up to the current cap. The annual point-to-point participation strategy credits the current participation rate multiplied by that change, uncapped. Neither ever credits less than the tier's index floor. Money withdrawn from an indexed strategy during the year earns no index credit for that year.

In words, the rate credited for a contract year is:

- *cap strategy* — the lower of the current cap and the S&P 500 change, and then the higher of that result and the index floor;
- *participation strategy* — the current participation rate multiplied by the S&P 500 change, and then the higher of that product and the index floor.

**3. Rate renewals.** Renewal rates for the next contract year are declared on each anniversary and are never below the tier's lowest cap ever declared and lowest participation rate ever declared. First-year rates are the tier's first-year cap and first-year participation rate.

**4. Reallocations.** A reallocation takes effect only on a contract anniversary. A reallocation request must be received no earlier than the reallocation window — 30 calendar days on every tier — before the next contract anniversary. The window opens on the day found by subtracting the window length in calendar days from the next contract anniversary; a request received on that day or later, up to the anniversary, applies on that anniversary. A request received before the window opens is not held and must be resubmitted within the window. A reallocation is accepted only while the contract status is active or income phase.

Both reallocation conditions are read from Ashgrove's records for the same contract before the reallocation is made: the next contract anniversary and the status from the contract record, and the date the request was received from the service request record.

### Index credit worked through (hypothetical changes; cap 9.5%, participation rate 45%, index floor 0%)

| S&P 500 change over the contract year | Cap strategy credit | Participation strategy credit |
|---|---|---|
| plus 12% | lower of 9.5% and 12% is 9.5%; credited 9.5% | 45% of 12% is 5.4%; credited 5.4% |
| plus 6% | lower of 9.5% and 6% is 6%; credited 6% | 45% of 6% is 2.7%; credited 2.7% |
| minus 8% | lower of 9.5% and minus 8% is minus 8%; floor gives 0% | 45% of minus 8% is minus 3.6%; floor gives 0% |

### Reallocation window on a hypothetical calendar

Next contract anniversary: 15 March 2027. Window length: 30 calendar days. Counting back 30 calendar days from 15 March 2027 gives 13 February 2027, the day the window opens.

| Request received | Result |
|---|---|
| 12 February 2027 (the day before the window opens) | Before the window; not held, and must be resubmitted within the window |
| 13 February 2027 (the opening day) | In the window; applies on 15 March 2027 |
| 1 March 2027 | In the window; applies on 15 March 2027 |

### Status and reallocation

| Contract status on the record | Reallocation accepted? |
|---|---|
| active | Yes |
| income phase | Yes |
| applied, surrendered, annuitized, death claim pending or any other status | No |

### Basis Q&A

**Does a request received in the window change the allocation at once?** No. A reallocation takes effect only on the anniversary; a request received in the window applies on that anniversary.

**Can a negative S&P 500 year reduce the contract value through an indexed strategy?** No. Neither strategy credits less than the index floor.
